name: inline-keys
description: Save API keys and passwords through a one-time localhost or private-LAN form without placing plaintext in Codex chat or MCP results.

interface.shortDescription: Enter project credentials outside Codex chat
interface.longDescription: Inline Keys opens a one-time localhost or explicitly requested private-LAN form for API keys and passwords, writes the submitted value directly to an approved dotenv or raw file, and returns only value-blind status to Codex.
defaultPrompt: Securely add an API key to this project's .env.local file.
Open a private localhost form for a password and save it without putting it in chat.
Open an Inline Keys form over my private LAN so I can submit from another device.
Check whether my pending Inline Keys request was completed.
